home.subtitle: Gabriel Hernández
home.description: Specialized in creating innovative and scalable web solutions, combining modern design with cutting-edge technology to deliver exceptional user experiences.
home.aboutDescription: I am a frontend developer passionate about turning complex ideas into engaging and functional digital experiences. With over two years of professional experience, I have collaborated with teams on innovative projects, such as an interactive math book, and participated in the development of dynamic web applications using React, Node.js, and other modern technologies. My approach integrates creativity, technical precision, and a mathematical touch to design interfaces that not only stand out visually but also provide practical solutions to real-world problems.

alcarvan.title: Frontend Developer
alcarvan.description: Development of interactive math books, focused on digitizing educational content and creating intuitive user experiences.
alcarvan.point1: Implementation of Playwright for E2E testing, ensuring software quality across more than 150 interactive scenarios.
alcarvan.point2: Design and development of interfaces for visualizing complex mathematical concepts, enhancing user comprehension.
alcarvan.point3: Creation of a robust testing structure to ensure project stability.

trigon.title: Frontend Developer
trigon.description: Frontend development with React, focused on creating dynamic and responsive interfaces.
trigon.point1: Development of reusable React components to improve code efficiency.
trigon.point2: Implementation of frontend solutions for interactive web applications.
trigon.point3: Collaboration in designing and developing user-centered interfaces.

truco.title: Truco Club (Full Stack Developer)
truco.description: Led the end-to-end development of the core game engine and systems architecture for a competitive real-time gaming platform, prioritizing scalability and low latency.
truco.point1: Engineered a deterministic rules engine in TypeScript, managing dynamic card hierarchies, move validation, and complex game states (Envido, Truco, Flor).
truco.point2: Designed a real-time bidirectional communication layer using WebSockets and NestJS, featuring advanced reconnection policies and Redis-backed state persistence.
truco.point3: Optimized game loop lifecycle and integrated engagement features like instant rematches within a high-performance reactive UI built with Next.js.

guitars-la.name: GuitarLA
guitars-la.description: A fully functional e-commerce platform built with Next.js, offering advanced pagination, seamless PostgreSQL integration, and a dynamic shopping cart system for an enhanced user experience.

product-hunt.name: Product Hunt Clone
product-hunt.description: A real-time Product Hunt replica using Firebase for authentication and data storage, Next.js for server-side rendering, and Styled Components for a modern, sleek interface.

mern-uptask.name: MERN-Uptask
mern-uptask.description: A real-time task management application using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and Socket.io for instant updates and collaborative features.

veterinary-control.name: Veterinary Control
veterinary-control.description: A comprehensive veterinary appointment management system developed with React and TailwindCSS, designed to streamline clinical operations and improve scheduling efficiency.

create-interactive.name: Create Interactive
create-interactive.description: An offline-first CRUD application using IndexDB for robust local storage, ensuring a seamless and uninterrupted user experience even without an internet connection.

expense-manager.name: Expense Manager
expense-manager.description: A personal finance tracking tool built with React and localStorage, allowing users to manage budgets effectively with persistent storage and intuitive controls.

drink-finder.name: Drink Finder
drink-finder.description: A cocktail discovery app integrated with an external API, using React Context for efficient state management and a responsive design powered by Bootstrap.

weather-app.name: Weather App
weather-app.description: A real-time weather dashboard developed with React Context and TailwindCSS, providing accurate, up-to-date global forecasts in a clean, user-friendly interface.

car-insurance.name: Insurance Calculator
car-insurance.description: A dynamic car insurance premium calculator built with React Context and TailwindCSS, offering real-time analysis of various factors for accurate insurance estimates.

news-finder.name: News Finder
news-finder.description: A multi-category news aggregator using React Context for state management and Material-UI for a modern, responsive, and visually appealing interface.

instant-cryptos.name: Instant Cryptos
instant-cryptos.description: A real-time cryptocurrency tracking platform with an integrated currency converter and advanced market analysis tools, designed for both casual users and serious investors.

vaccine-manager.name: Vaccine Manager
vaccine-manager.description: A comprehensive livestock vaccine management application developed with React, Express, and MongoDB. It allows user registration, detailed vaccine information management, guide creation for transporters, and generation of vaccinated cattle declarations, with the option to download all documents in PDF format. It uses React Router for smooth and efficient navigation, providing a robust and user-friendly solution for vaccination process tracking and control.
